newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London up ahead of HSBC 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London up ahead of HSBC 1996 results.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London were higher on Friday as the market bought aggressively into HSBC ahead of their 1996 results due out on Monday, market-makers said.

The Hang Seng reference index in London was 37.53 points, or 0.28 percent, firmer at 13,436.25 at 1450 GMT, after the Hang Seng index in Hong Kong closed 147.88 points or 1.09 percent lower at 13,398.72.
"All the buying has been in HSBC. The rest of the market is not really moving," one market-maker said.
HSBC was more than HK$3.5 above its Hong Kong close at HK$192.675.

HSBC is expected to announce 1996 pre-tax profits of more than 4.6 billion stg, compared with 3.67 billion in 1995, traders said.HSBC was also expected to raise its dividend to around 40p from 32p the previous year, dealers said.
